name: Search Tickets
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Finds tickets by requester, status, priority, type, tags, organization, external ID, or date. Combine filters, or supply a raw Zendesk search query for full control.

inputs.name: requester_email
inputs.label: Requester Email
inputs.hint: Matches tickets requested by this email address.

inputs.name: ticket_status
inputs.label: Status
inputs.hint: One of: new, open, pending, hold, solved, closed.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.label: Priority
inputs.hint: One of: urgent, high, normal, low.

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: Ticket Type
inputs.hint: One of: problem, incident, question, task.

inputs.name: ticket_tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.hint: Comma-separated list of tags — matches tickets having ALL of these tags.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.label: Organization ID
inputs.hint: Numeric Zendesk organization ID — visible in the organization's URL under Admin Center → People → Organizations.

inputs.name: created_after
inputs.label: Created After
inputs.hint: Date (YYYY-MM-DD), or an ISO datetime (only the date portion is used — Zendesk search doesn't filter by time of day).

inputs.name: updated_after
inputs.label: Updated After
inputs.hint: Date (YYYY-MM-DD), or an ISO datetime (only the date portion is used — Zendesk search doesn't filter by time of day).

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.label: External ID
inputs.hint: Matches tickets with this External ID (set via Create Ticket or Update Ticket).

inputs.name: raw_query
inputs.label: Raw Query
inputs.hint: Raw Zendesk search query fragment (see Zendesk's search syntax docs). If set, this REPLACES every filter above — combined only with a fixed type:ticket.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.hint: Maximum number of matching tickets to return; paginates automatically to satisfy this. Zendesk caps search at 1,000 total results (100/page, 10 pages) — requests above that are clamped. Defaults to 100 if left unset.

outputs.name: tickets
outputs.label: Tickets
outputs.hint: JSON array string of matching tickets, each with id/subject/status/priority/requester_id/updated_at/ticket_url.

outputs.name: count
outputs.label: Count
outputs.hint: Number of tickets included in Tickets.
